value.answer: Drooling, chewing on everything and some fussiness is very often teething. First molars usually come in around 13 to 19 months, and a cold (not frozen) teething toy can help. Teething shouldn't cause fever, real crying, vomiting or diarrhea, so those would point to something else.
value.triage: Call Health811 at 811, any time, if there's a fever, real crying, refusing to eat or drink, or it's getting worse. Go to the ER or call 911 now if your child looks very sick, is hard to wake, or is struggling to breathe.
sources: Pediatric guidance on teething from search notes
